paragraphs: Avimi bar Nazi, father-in-law of Ravina (read: of Ravinai). Bava Kamma 115a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: חמוה explicitly gives father-in-law. “Read: of Ravinai” is Hyman’s parenthetical correction of Ravina, not a newly verified variant. Ravina and Ravinai are names here, without a separate title.
קטו. gives Bava Kamma 115a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
